_help: District court cases to track. Each needs a CourtListener docket id (the number in courtlistener.com/docket/<id>/...). 'listen' is optional; for D.D.C. the judge's public line is looked up automatically. Briefs (overview + history) are written when a case is added and refreshed when the docket shows major new events. Hand-written briefs live in editorial/district.json and take priority.
